_noteQEmpowerNoOp: Q, ASKED ABOUT AND CORRECTLY UNCHANGED FOR A SINGLE TARGET (loop 483, user asked whether the auto is empowered by Q). It is empowered, and for THIS calculator that adds nothing. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nilah, fetched 2026-08-21): the cast itself deals the damage already curated here, and hitting with it grants 4 seconds during which her basic attacks strike in a CONE dealing 100% AD to enemies hit, plus 125 attack range and 10-60% attack speed. The cone IS the attack, not a rider on top of it - the primary target takes one attack either way, and what the buff adds is reach, speed and spillover onto OTHER enemies. This project models one target, so there is no honest number to add; curating the cone as an on-hit rider would double the attack against the very target it does not affect. The attack-speed half is a rate, not damage per cast, and this calculator does not model combo duration.
